finalReview.productManagerStatement: Accepted. The original defect is fixed at the right place: submissionAttempted is no longer set when a process or batch handoff merely starts. Both the direct run-root path and the batch child now enter the shared round as run-starting/submissionAttempted=false, and the flip to true happens in exactly one mutex-held compare-and-swap inside Invoke-RootWaitRound (line 2854) immediately before the single Invoke-WatchAdapterSend call (line 2856). A capacity slot left behind before that line can now be released with an auditable never-invoked proof; anything at or past that line stays isolated as ConcurrencySlotRecoveryRequired. All three conditions from your previous rejection are met. The strict-predicate inconsistency is genuinely fixed in code, which I verified directly: Get-ValidatedCapacityHandoff now calls the same Test-CapacityClaimSchemaVersion and Test-CapacitySubmissionNotAttempted helpers used by the submission boundary and the release proof, so a coerced string, decimal, double, null, array or object schema value is rejected identically at handoff, at transition and at release. AC8 is checked in prd.md and implement.md now records focused Pester 134/134, a combined watcher-plus-adapter run, and the final 322/322 (watcher 134/134, adapter 188/188); SKILL.md confirms those two files are what the full sidebar suite means. Phase 3.3 and 3.4 are done, committed locally at 685e680 with nothing pushed, published or installed. The conservative boundaries you asked for are intact. The never-invoked branch is evaluated last, after every existing durable retry, pre-click, adapter-terminal and watcher-terminal proof, and it fires only when there is no durable evidence file at all, the claim is canonical schema 2, the phase is exactly run-starting, submissionAttempted is a real boolean false with no timestamp, and watcherId and terminalStatus are both empty. Nothing infers not sent from a blank page or a missing file, no recovery path touches the adapter or the browser, and no idempotency or target claim is ever deleted. Only the capacity claim schema moved to 2; watcher schema and batch manifest schema are still pinned to 1, and the 3-per-task, 6-global and 7200-second limits are unchanged. Two honest limits on this review. First, Pester is not installed in the review sandbox, so I could not re-execute the suite; I corroborated the 322/322 claim statically (It-block counts consistent with the totals after -TestCases expansion, zero parse errors on both changed files, and every regression the spec requires present in the test file) but the number itself remains your recorded result rather than something I reproduced. If you want that independently reproducible, save the Pester summary output into the task evidence directory on the next run. Second, the supplied snapshot omitted the .agents directory, so I read the implementation and test files from the worktree at the same clean HEAD 1c01b19. Remaining open items are the archive/finish-work step, which is correctly gated on this acceptance, and the pre-deploy check that no batch is in flight, which avoids interleaving old and new parent/child handoff versions. Neither blocks acceptance.

Keep implement.md line 64 open until you have confirmed there is no in-flight batch, so that no old parent hands off to a new child across the schema-1/schema-2 boundary.

latestAdvice.productManagerStatement: 这个改动解决了你报告的真实故障：以前 run-root 和批处理父进程在真正调用 adapter 之前就把容量槽标成「已尝试提交」，结果一个从未发出任何内容的空槽会被永久占用，只能人工清理。现在容量 claim 使用独立的 schema 2（watcher 与 batch manifest 仍是 1），槽在整个启动、参数校验和 batch 交接期间保持 run-starting/submissionAttempted=false，只有在 Invoke-RootWaitRound 里紧邻唯一一次 Invoke-WatchAdapterSend 之前，才由一个持锁的 compare-and-swap 原子写入 true 和时间戳；直接路径与 batch child 共用这同一个边界，child 不再二次获取容量，父进程仍是唯一释放者。恢复侧是保守的：只有 schema 2、run-starting、真布尔 false、没有任何 state.json/watch-state.json/watch-event.json/evidence.json、且没有 watcherId 或 terminalStatus 的 claim 才会被判为 never-invoked 并安全回收；旧 schema、已越过边界的 true、身份或版本不匹配、以及任何矛盾的持久证据，依旧返回 ConcurrencySlotRecoveryRequired 并保留槽。恢复路径不碰浏览器、不重发、不删 idempotency/target claim，3/6/7200 的限额和既有绑定都没有变。你上次拒收的两点都已落实：Get-ValidatedCapacityHandoff 现在与 CAS、释放路径共用同一套严格谓词（只接受 Int32/Int64 的规范整数 2），AC8 记录也已刷新为完整 sidebar 322/322（watcher 134/134、adapter 188/188）。需要说明的是，本次审查环境禁止执行外部程序，所以这些测试数字和「diff 不含无关改动」是转述实施方的结果，我没有重新跑一遍复核。剩下未勾选的两项是有意留在验收之后的：trellis-finish-work/archive，以及部署或回滚前确认没有 in-flight batch——后者建议保留为发布门禁，避免新旧 parent/child 交接版本交错。
